text.text_excerpt: Its 4am on a Saturday and I'm on my way to work. I need cash, string cheese, a Hubigs, a couple of 5hr energy drinks, and a belated birthday card. Thank you Walgreen's for being there to meet these needs! Its 2am and I'm be driven back home from a night out. I need vodka, a Hubigs (yes I realize I need these quite often), and some toothpaste. Walgreen's to the rescue again! All this in one complete package that includes in-store entertainment if you drop by the hours of, well actually it could be any time of day. It's a Walgreen's for Pete's sake! Did you really need to read a review about Walgreen's? Well yes you did, because you needed to know that this one allows you to get cash back f...

This review is primarily for the pharmacy. I recently got really fed up with the complete and utter mediocrity (and that's being very generous) that was the Walmart pharmacy and took my business here instead. I'm really glad I did - the pharmacists have always been helpful, and since Walgreens is in my healthcare Rx provider network, I'm finally getting some prescriptions for free (oh yeah, Obamacare!!) I really dig the "Reply to this email and we'll refill your prescription" thing. Nifty. Usually the wait for prescriptions (if you've already requested a refill) isn't too long. And since the pharmacy is open 24 hours, I kind of like knowing I can go there at 4:00 am, even though I've than...

So I mostly end up at this Walgreens late at night and that's why it's getting a review...a 24 hours shop on St. Charles....excellent location for people watching. Drunk tourists, random local nuts (waves), and folks who just want to chat with you at 2 in the morning while you are in urgent need of...whatever. AND the staff handles all this with aplomb and amusement. This location does have a huge makeup selection. And some good local stuff, including souvenirs and then there is the random things like sundresses or scrubs. Weird. In summation, I think it's probably a 3 star store, but the people make it worthy of 4.
